site_surface.short_summary: Jund is a VM-186 live-pilot Alara shard expression for Red-centered black-red-green freedom, instinct, appetite, and survival under consequence.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Jund asks what the self becomes when feeling, hunger, and instinct are trusted before permission.
site_surface.tagline: Trust the feeling. Feed the hunger. Bear the consequence.
best_for: readers drawn to Red-centered instinct and self-truth
players who prefer appetite, pressure, and action under consequence
reviewers checking that Jund stays separate from Naya, Grixis, Gruul, Rakdos, Golgari, Witherbloom, Riveteers, and Modern Jund
content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Jund material can involve survival pressure, appetite, violence-adjacent imagery, and deferred predator/ecology topics. This packet does not narrate detailed story-world claims as current evidence.
site_surface.summary: Jund reads as instinct under consequence: Red follows feeling first, Black protects appetite and need, and Green turns that signal into embodied force. Setting danger may color the tone, but the identity must remain anchored in the BRG philosophy rather than generic savagery or Modern Jund shorthand.

core_identity.summary: Jund is the BRG expression of feeling acted on without White-Blue restraint. Its useful Commander signal is not anger alone, death magic, or efficient midrange play; it is appetite, gut truth, and instinct becoming force where the world answers back.
core_identity.philosophy: Red supplies the center: being true to oneself, following gut instinct, and doing what feels right. Black supports appetite and self-advocacy. Green supports unrestrained instinct and embodied force.
core_identity.central_tension: Vox Mana models Jund's tension as freedom through appetite and instinct drifting into flattening, overconsumption, or mistaking impulse for truth.
core_identity.interpretive_note: Central-tension and product-language compression are Vox Mana modeling from VM-176, VM-177, and VM-178. They are not official Wizards or MTG canon.
unknowns: Detailed Jund geography, settlements, named places, species, social structures, and ecology
Kresh, Meren, Rakka Mar, Karrthus, Sarkhan Vol, and other figure biographies beyond separately verified card facts
Devour as a whole identity, complete predator ecology, or total social metaphysics
Modern Jund midrange culture as anything other than player-format context
Fine-grained predator hierarchy, dragon rule, volcanic details, or creature ecology
core_identity.philosophical_axis: Red self-truth leads, Black defends need and appetite, and Green makes instinct physical under real consequence.

structure.summary: The structure should keep Red as the interpretive center, use Black and Green as supporting pressures, and treat Alara story material as context only when it clarifies survival pressure or Grixis rupture boundaries.
supported_elements: Jund as a black-red-green Alara shard
Self-truth, gut instinct, and doing what feels right
Freedom with action and survival consequences
Black self-interest, personal needs, contentment, and resistance to White constraint
Green unrestrained instinct, less overthinking, and feral force
White and Blue as missing pressures at design-philosophy scope only
Boundary against generic Red violence, savage nature, devour, and Modern Jund
review_gated_elements: Commander/operator rows as product support only
Local Scryfall card facts as future claim-by-claim support only
Rakdos, Golgari, and Gruul articles as color-philosophy support only
Naya and Grixis as comparator rails only
manual_review_required: Do not narrate detailed geography before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not narrate figures, rulers, or named story roles before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not turn devour into the whole identity before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not narrate Conflux chronology before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not use Modern Jund midrange as Jund canon or metaphysics.

great_tension.summary: Jund must stay vivid without collapsing into cruelty, generic savagery, devour lore, or Modern Jund midrange. Its tension is whether instinct is trusted because it is true and embodied, or merely indulged because it is loud.
great_tension.placement_relevance: VM-186 live-pilot placement note. Use only with VM-176 evidence boundaries and without converting support-only Commander, mechanics, or comparator material into claims.

historical_timeline.event: Alara's local shard context includes Jund among the shard identities.
historical_timeline.summary: Alara's Jund context supplies survival pressure, dragon-world danger, and later Grixis death-magic rupture as bounded setting signals; it does not replace the Rosewater color-philosophy frame.

views_on_other_factions.relationship_summary: Vox Mana separator only: Jund should not be replaced by Naya's Green-centered communal/behemoth ecology.
views_on_other_factions.evidence_type: VM-176 boundary and VM-178 architecture separator
views_on_other_factions.summary: Naya shares creature scale and bodily force, but it treats awe, community, and sacred life as central. Jund instead tests feeling through appetite, survival pressure, and consequence-bearing instinct.

views_on_other_factions.relationship_summary: Vox Mana separator only: Jund shares Black/Red danger but replaces Blue calculation with Green instinct and keeps Red as center.
views_on_other_factions.evidence_type: VM-176 boundary and VM-178 architecture separator
views_on_other_factions.summary: Grixis leans into death magic, decay, and extraction; Jund should treat necromancy as an outside rupture or comparator, not native identity proof.

mechanics.summary: Use devour, sacrifice, graveyard value, lands, counters, tokens, combat pressure, and value engines as support-only mechanical echoes of Jund appetite, survival, and consequence. They are not lore-canon proof, raw claims, or substitutes for the source-bound Red-centered identity floor.

commander_curation_patterns.pattern: Exact Black/Red/Green Commander rows can provide support-only operator vocabulary around counters, lands, graveyards, sacrifice, tokens, combat pressure, and value engines.
commander_curation_patterns.notes: These rows are not Jund canon evidence and do not become raw claims.

mechanics.notes: Support-only material must not raise raw-claim confidence, create raw claims, or imply placement readiness.

search_and_filter_metadata.notes: Aliases and related terms support the VM-186 live pilot. BRG remains metadata only and is not an alias surface, route key, fixture key, generated key, public label, or lookup key.

commander_compass.recommendation_philosophy: Use Jund Commander guidance as product/operator support only: exact Black/Red/Green decks can express instinctive pressure, appetite engines, feral value, sacrifice, graveyard value, lands, counters, tokens, and consequence-bearing combat. These rows do not create Jund canon, geography, story, creature ecology, or raw claims.

owned_themes: Green unrestrained instinct and embodied force
resource conversion that makes consequence visible
avoid_or_contrast_phrases: Jund story validation from Commander rows
Riveteers family or labor identity as Jund
adjacent_overlap_notes: Sacrifice and drain language must stay Jund-side and not become Rakdos spectacle or Witherbloom life-drain doctrine.
Graveyard and lands language must stay appetite/survival support and not become Golgari lifecycle or Grixis death-world doctrine.
Combat pressure must stay Red-centered appetite and consequence, not Gruul civilization-rejection or Naya communal/behemoth ecology.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: Power Hungry is an exact Black/Red/Green support deck, and Prossh turns bodies into resources, pressure, and consequence without making sacrifice a canon claim.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: The player wants low-threat table politics, slow control, or Jund story validation rather than appetite-engine gameplay.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: Make bodies, spend bodies, and turn each sacrifice into a clock the table has to answer before the hunger compounds.
caution_notes: Product/operator support only; not Jund canon evidence.
Do not display with public color-code match wording.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: World Shaper is an exact Black/Red/Green support deck, and Hearthhull frames lands and graveyard value as spent material returning as pressure.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: The player wants a commander that wins through pure combat speed or a lore-canon Jund figure.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: Let lands, graveyards, and sacrificed resources feed the next turn so survival becomes pressure instead of merely recovery.
caution_notes: Product/operator support only; not Jund canon evidence.
Keep lands/graveyard copy away from Golgari lifecycle or Grixis death-world doctrine.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: Graveyard Overdrive is an exact Black/Red/Green support deck, and Disa turns discarded or dead material into survival-after-impact pressure.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: The player wants Alaran story figures, pure sacrifice combo, or a deck with no graveyard exposure.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: Stock the graveyard, keep threat density alive, and let what was spent return as force before the table stabilizes.
caution_notes: Product/operator support only; not Jund canon evidence.
Do not treat Disa's non-Jund story context as Jund lore.

weird_stretch_commanders.why_this_fits: Riveteers Rampage is exact Black/Red/Green product support, and Henzie can express speed, cost, and temporary pressure when kept away from Riveteers faction doctrine.
weird_stretch_commanders.skip_if: The player is reading Riveteers family, labor, or New Capenna identity as if it were Jund.
weird_stretch_commanders.gameplay_summary: Use temporary threats, haste, and sacrifice timing as pressure tools, then rebuild from the value they leave behind.
caution_notes: Same-color product support only; Riveteers identity remains a Jund false positive.
Do not display as a lore-forward Jund recommendation.

budget_friendly_commanders.why_this_fits: Blight Curse is an exact Black/Red/Green support deck where counters, sacrifice, and attrition can read as careful appetite/consequence pressure.
budget_friendly_commanders.skip_if: The player wants the cleanest classic Jund sacrifice engine or dislikes counter-management gameplay.
budget_friendly_commanders.gameplay_summary: Weaken the board, manage the cost, and turn attrition into leverage without claiming counter attrition is Jund canon.
caution_notes: Product/operator support only; not Jund canon evidence.

advanced_complexity_commanders.why_this_fits: Nature's Vengeance is an exact Black/Red/Green support deck where land recursion and graveyard value can serve Jund's survival/resource-conversion lane.
advanced_complexity_commanders.skip_if: The player wants a simple creature combat deck or wants land recursion treated as Jund story canon.
advanced_complexity_commanders.gameplay_summary: Make lands into the engine: discard, recur, replay, and turn the mana base itself into pressure.
caution_notes: Product/operator support only; not Jund canon evidence.
Land recursion is a Commander lane, not a new Jund lore claim.

archetype_lanes.description: Act from gut truth, make pressure visible, and force the table to answer before comfort becomes a plan.
archetype_lanes.recommended_for: Prossh, Skyraider of Kher; Henzie "Toolbox" Torre
archetype_lanes.skip_if: The player wants slow permission control or pressure without consequence.

archetype_lanes.description: Turn bodies, counters, sacrifice, and spent resources into momentum that makes every exchange expensive.
archetype_lanes.recommended_for: Prossh, Skyraider of Kher; Auntie Ool, Cursewretch
archetype_lanes.skip_if: The deck becomes generic aristocrats, generic cruelty, or mechanics-as-canon.

archetype_lanes.description: Use lands, graveyards, and Green instinct to keep pressure alive after the first strike.
archetype_lanes.recommended_for: Hearthhull, the Worldseed; Disa the Restless; Lord Windgrace
archetype_lanes.skip_if: The deck is really Golgari lifecycle, Grixis death-world value, or Naya abundance.
